organizationId.description: ID of the contact center organization. This field is required for all bulk save operations.

id.description: ID of this contact center resource. It should not be specified when creating a new resource. However, it is mandatory when updating a resource.

version.description: The version of this resource. For a newly created resource, it will be 0 unless specified otherwise.

dialledNumber.description: The dialed number(DN) used to map to entry points.

extension.description: The extension used to map to entry points.

routingPrefix.description: The routing prefix is mapped to a location and can be prefixed with an extension

esn.description: The esn is routing prefix with extension

routePointId.description: The identifier of a route point of WxC which is similar to entry point of WxCC

entryPointId.description: The identifier of an entry point to which you want to map the DN.

entryPointName.description: The entryPoint name of the entryPointId.

defaultAni.description:
The default dial number for the tenant to make outdial calls. The default dial number is displayed in the customer's caller ID, if an agent does not select a specific outdial ANI (Automatic Number Identification) for an outdial call.

A default value is automatically set once and entry point mapping is created

location.description: The name of the location as configured on Webex Calling(applicable only for Webex Calling).

regionId.description:
Specify the telephony region id.

You can pass id for one of these regions:

US (USA), CA (Canada), MX (Mexico), AU (Australia), SG (Singapore), GB (United Kingdom), DE (Germany)

You can retrieve it by calling /api/global/telephony-region API.

createdTime.description: This is the created time of the entity.

lastUpdatedTime.description: This is the updated time of the entity.
